# `assemble-changelog.yml`

## Inputs

| Name | Description | Type | Default | Required |
| :--- | :---------- | :--- | :------ | :------: |
| changelog_dir | Directory holding unassembled fragments | `string` | `changelog.d` | no |
| changelog_file | Path to the assembled changelog | `string` | `CHANGELOG.md` | no |
| runner_labels | Runner labels as JSON array (e.g., ["self-hosted", "oke"]) | `string` | `["ubuntu-24.04"]` | no |
| version_file | Path to the version file | `string` | `VERSION` | no |
| version_file_type | File type: 'plain' or 'json' | `string` | `plain` | no |
| version_json_key | Key holding the version when version_file_type is json | `string` | `version` | no |

## Secrets

| Name | Description | Required |
| :--- | :---------- | :------: |
| app_client_id | Client ID of the tnoff-ci GitHub App (CI_APP_CLIENT_ID). The Iv23li... form, NOT the numeric App ID -- create-github-app-token deprecated its `app-id` input in favour of `client-id`. The numeric ID is still what the ruleset bypass actor keys on, so both exist and they are not interchangeable. | yes |
| app_private_key | Private key PEM of the tnoff-ci GitHub App (CI_APP_PRIVATE_KEY). | yes |

## Outputs

| Name | Description |
| :--- | :---------- |
| assembled | Whether a fold commit was pushed (true/false) |
